sections.title: Distance standards overview
sections.content:
## Purpose

Distance standards declare the standard distance for each route so you can control the operating mileage, calculate salary per kilometre or per route, compare against actual GPS data, and set the allowed margin of error.

## Access

**Menu:** Driver salary > Distance standards

![](/uploads/548f379b9c44855fe4b85536.png)

sections.title: Creating a distance standard
sections.content:
### Step 1

Click **New**.

![](/uploads/6813d9c264b4e958fed0f595.png)

### Step 2

Enter the distance standard information.

![](/uploads/1e9e0888c38883fa8a9c4f40.png)

| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Name | Name of the distance standard. |
| Location | Location it applies to. |
| Route | Transport route it applies to. |
| Standard distance (km) | Standard number of kilometres for the route. |
| Maximum distance (km) | Maximum number of kilometres allowed; this is a limit, not the standard distance. |
| % Buffer | Percentage by which the standard distance may be exceeded. |
| Effective date | Date the standard starts applying. |
| Company | Company the data applies to. |

### Step 3

Fill in the required fields: name, location, effective date, standard distance and company.

![](/uploads/2fad76ec3e945012c5e47ae7.png)

### Step 4

Click **Save manually**.

![](/uploads/30faee53fb8635e623d89387.png)

The new distance standard appears in the list.

![](/uploads/ba35adb8b8e3d1506a10c480.png)

## Duplicating a distance standard

The **Duplicate** function quickly creates a new record from existing data; afterwards, review it and change whatever needs to differ.

sections.title: Duplicating from the list
sections.content:
### Step 1

Select one or more rows in the list. The **Actions** button appears.

![](/uploads/0cc936621b8b3815aef22d13.png)

![](/uploads/27d5755c22c812e228ac09a9.png)

### Step 2

Under **Actions**, select **Duplicate**.

![](/uploads/fcfa2bdc69ffa9b8d6cd1e7c.png)

### Step 3

The system creates the new record and shows it at the top of the list.

![](/uploads/eec23a8f8c3dbdf151922382.png)

sections.title: Duplicating from the details screen
sections.content:
### Step 1

Open the record you want to duplicate.

![](/uploads/ccf5fe95f7e7fbd52e28546c.png)

### Step 2

Select the **Actions** icon on the details screen.

![](/uploads/b2e1705e6a6c975a43e0ad66.png)

![](/uploads/3ad2d74beb0d7248864860e2.png)

### Step 3

Select **Duplicate**.

![](/uploads/01d45247d88cf225e4436080.png)

The system opens the newly created record.

![](/uploads/7570b42915819d77cbce0074.png)
